title: Compare candidates and regression
description:
# Compare candidates and regression

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want to rank two or three candidate texts and to compare a working copy to the original, so I can pick a shortlist and catch quality regressions before I bother a human.

## Done when

- `limatus compare` takes a style profile plus two or more candidate files (or original + working copy).
- Output lists **all** candidates with ranks, always-lane **deltas** (finding counts by kind, density numbers), and optional judge rubric deltas when a judge is configured.
- Hard fail: a candidate that **increases unsupported claims** (or other configured hard constraints) cannot be rank 1; the report says why.
- Ranking does not hide losers.
- Neither input file is modified.
- This replaces weighted `should_accept_revision` as the agent-facing “is B better than A?” tool. `verify` may remain as a compatibility alias that calls compare, or is documented as superseded.

## Out of scope

Auto-applying the winner. Auto-publish. Multi-provider judges.
